deficiencies.description: The source text is unclear as to whether 'it' in 'it's defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue' refers to 'invasion' or 'malignancy'. The rewrite resolves this unclear statement by choosing one reading ('malignancy is defined as...').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So invasion and malignancy are really, really important diagnostically. So it's defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion and malignancy are very important diagnostically, and malignancy is defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite replaces the lecturer's pointing word 'this' with the specific description 'Invasion', which the lecturer did not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this is probably an obligatory step in getting to having a malignant metastasizing tumor.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion is therefore probably an obligatory step in arriving at a malignant, metastasising tumour.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing phrase 'over here' into the description 'Elsewhere in the same lesion'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You'll see that over here you have the adenoma which has progressed into an adenocarcinoma.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Elsewhere in the same lesion is the adenoma, which has progressed into an adenocarcinoma, so that one is growing out of the other.

considerations.sourcePassage: and you'll be able to look at this in great detail in the practicals
considerations.reason: Omitted as an allowed change because it is a statement about the course or practical sessions.

considerations.sourcePassage: But the question is, of course, you would then be interested in figuring out whether or not there would be secondary metastases across the body.
